entities.summary: Alexei Nikolaevich Litvinenko is a retired ice hockey defenceman. He last played for Barys Astana in the Kontinental Hockey League. He was drafted 262nd overall by the Phoenix Coyotes in the 9th round of the 1999 NHL Entry Draft.
